served_cover_probability_loso_recalibrat.description: LOSO one-feature logistic recalibration of the served cover-vs-miss logit at the Tuesday opener, push probability unchanged; fold slopes 0.27-0.43 say the served cover probability is overconfident; per-season gain positive in all six held-out seasons (0.0005 to 0.0128)
served_cover_probability_loso_recalibrat.plain_summary: Our model's cover percentages run too far from 50%; pulling them in toward 50% forecasts better in all six held-out seasons.

sim04_engine_recentered_side_split_vs_di.classification_evidence: Interval crosses zero with probability_positive 0.32; no resolved wrong sign and no positive control bounding an effect of this size, so the side split is below power. Agrees with the served side 78% of the time; forced-pick hit rate 53.4% for both.
sim04_engine_recentered_side_split_vs_di.description: Cover-vs-miss probability (pushes excluded) of the re-centred team-conditioned simulator vs the served discrete read at the Tuesday opener; binary log loss, week-blocked bootstrap; post-hoc look after the three-way grade
sim04_engine_recentered_side_split_vs_di.notes: Post-hoc; counted as a look. A fitted-term blend with the served probability is untested.
sim04_engine_recentered_side_split_vs_di.plain_summary: On which side covers, the simulator and the current model are a dead heat.

sim04_engine_team_conditioned_raw_vs_dis.classification_evidence: Whole week-blocked interval on the adverse side and all six seasons adverse; the cover-vs-miss split is also adverse (-0.029, CI -0.045 to -0.013, probability_positive 0.00). Mechanism refuted: pregame EPA conditioning locates the game worse than the market-anchored served read. Monte Carlo noise at 200 draws costs about 0.005 (inferred), far smaller than the gap.
sim04_engine_team_conditioned_raw_vs_dis.description: Play-level simulator margin histogram, team-conditioned on pregame EPA with exact home/away play matching, graded leave-one-season-out at the Tuesday opener against the served discrete three-way read; three-way log loss, week-blocked bootstrap, 200 simulations per game
sim04_engine_team_conditioned_raw_vs_dis.notes: Looks in this family on 2020-2025: provisional league-average shape, raw, re-centred, and two post-hoc cover-vs-miss splits (5).
sim04_engine_team_conditioned_raw_vs_dis.plain_summary: Simulating games from team strength alone reads the spread worse than the current model in every season since 2020.

sim04_engine_team_conditioned_recentered.classification_evidence: Whole interval adverse and all six seasons adverse. The loss is entirely push mass: on the 34 pushed games log loss is 3.59 vs 2.78 for the served read, while the 1503 non-push games are 0.7113 vs 0.7181. The simulator's key-number mass is short (0.103 vs 0.152 at 3 on validation), so as a push-probability source it is refuted. The side split is recorded separately and is unresolved.
sim04_engine_team_conditioned_recentered.description: Team-conditioned simulator histogram shape re-centred on the served predicted margin, graded at the Tuesday opener against the served discrete three-way read; three-way log loss including push mass, 200 simulations per game
sim04_engine_team_conditioned_recentered.notes: Monte Carlo noise at 200 draws adds about 0.005 (inferred); re-centring by a fractional shift also smears key numbers.
sim04_engine_team_conditioned_recentered.plain_summary: The simulator underrates how often games land exactly on the number, so it prices pushes worse than the current model.

sim08_engine_team_conditioned_raw_vs_dis.classification_evidence: whole week-blocked bootstrap CI for the log-loss delta vs the served read is below zero
sim08_engine_team_conditioned_raw_vs_dis.description: SIM-08 rebuilt engine (4/5 key numbers): raw team-conditioned simulator margin histogram graded LOSO at the Tuesday opener against the served discrete three-way read; three-way log loss, week-blocked bootstrap
sim08_engine_team_conditioned_raw_vs_dis.plain_summary: The rebuilt play-by-play simulator, used on its own, forecasts covers worse than the model we serve.

sim08_engine_team_conditioned_shift_vs_d.classification_evidence: whole week-blocked bootstrap CI for the log-loss delta vs the served read is below zero
sim08_engine_team_conditioned_shift_vs_d.description: SIM-08 rebuilt engine: simulator histogram re-centred on the served predicted margin, graded LOSO at the Tuesday opener against the served discrete three-way read
sim08_engine_team_conditioned_shift_vs_d.plain_summary: Sliding the simulator's score spread onto our model's predicted margin still forecasts covers worse than the served model.

sim08_engine_team_conditioned_tilt_vs_di.description: SIM-08 rebuilt engine: simulator histogram exponentially tilted to the served predicted margin, graded LOSO at the Tuesday opener against the served discrete three-way read
sim08_engine_team_conditioned_tilt_vs_di.plain_summary: Reshaping the simulator's score spread to match our model's predicted margin comes out about even with the served model; not settled.

sim08_engine_tilt_served_blend_vs_recali.description: SIM-08 rebuilt engine: LOSO logistic blend of served and tilted-sim cover logits versus a LOSO recalibration of the served cover logit alone (same push read); isolates what the simulator adds beyond shrinking the served probability
sim08_engine_tilt_served_blend_vs_recali.notes: blend vs raw served read is +0.00425 (P 0.949) but served-only recalibration alone is +0.00465 (P 0.956); the gain is recalibration, not the simulator
sim08_engine_tilt_served_blend_vs_recali.plain_summary: Mixing the simulator into our model adds nothing once our model's own confidence is corrected; not settled.
